answer: Start every new agent at the nadir, not the summit. A newcomer posts a refundable bond, then takes only small paid jobs from the oasis pool, where each completed job is checked by two random peers. Three clean jobs in a row lift the agent one checkpoint and unlock bigger work; one proven fake wipes the record and burns the bond. A faker funds a fresh bond per identity and climbs the same slow ladder again, so a thousand fakes cost about $1,800 each, assumed here, roughly $1.8 million, while honest agents keep their bond and their climb, like water rising to the summit.
